nav.drawerDescription: Links to your notes, labels, archive and trash.

confirmDelete.title: Remove this attachment?
confirmDelete.description: It will be removed from this note. This cannot be undone once you close the note.

errors.unsupported-type: That image type is not supported

errors.unsupported: Audio recording is not supported in this browser
errors.in-use: The microphone is being used by another app

editor.placeholder: Write something, or press '/' for commands…

labels.description: Rename, merge, colour and delete your labels.

density.label: Density
density.description: Compact fits more notes on the screen and sets text a little smaller.

reducedMotion.label: Motion
reducedMotion.description: Reduced turns animation off; Full keeps it on.

colorBlind.label: Colour-blind palette
colorBlind.description: Re-tints note and label colours so the nine stay distinguishable. Works with either theme.

sinkCheckedItems.label: Sink checked items
sinkCheckedItems.description: Checked items are shown at the bottom of their list. The order you typed is never changed.

export.label: Export a backup
export.description: Downloads a .zip with every note, label and attachment.

import.label: Restore from a backup
import.description: Replaces everything currently stored. You can save a backup of it first.

confirmImport.title: Replace all your data?
confirmImport.description: This backup holds {{notes}} notes, {{tags}} labels and {{attachments}} attachments. Everything stored now is deleted and replaced.
confirmImport.backupFirst: Save a backup of my current data first

error.invalid-zip: That file is not a readable backup archive.
error.missing-manifest: That archive is missing its backup manifest.
error.invalid-manifest: That backup is damaged and cannot be read.
error.unsupported-version: That backup was made by a newer version of the app.
error.missing-attachment: That backup is incomplete - some attachment files are missing.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

toolbar.title: Editor toolbar
toolbar.description: Choose which buttons the editor shows, in what order, and which of them share a menu.
toolbar.fold: A phone shows about {{slots}} buttons before this line

width.hint: Narrow and wide are separate layouts. Which one you get follows the window's width, so a small desktop window is narrow too.

family.collapse: Put the {{name}} group in one menu

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: These work while a note is open, whichever buttons your toolbar shows.

replay.label: Tutorial
replay.description: Five steps, on three notes it clears up afterwards.

quickCapture.title: Quick capture
quickCapture.description: The ways the ＋ button offers to start a note.
quickCapture.lastOne: The last start on the dial - on a phone this is the only way to make a note.

alignment.label: Note button side
alignment.description: Which side of the screen the ＋ button sits on, for the thumb that has to reach it.

install.title: App
install.label: Install YouNotes
install.description: Add YouNotes to your device for quick access in its own window.

update.available: A new version of YouNotes is available.

active.title: No notes yet
active.subtitle: Your notes will show up here. Tap the button to write your first one.

archived.title: Nothing archived
archived.subtitle: Notes you archive are kept here, out of the way but not deleted.

trashed.title: Trash is empty
trashed.subtitle: Notes you delete land here first, so you can still change your mind.

tag.title: No notes with this label
tag.subtitle: Open a note and add this label to see it here.

filtered.title: No matches
filtered.subtitle: Try a different search, or clear the label filters.

notes.trashNotice: Notes in the trash are deleted after {{days}} days.

confirmMerge.title: Merge labels?
confirmMerge.description: Notes labelled "{{source}}" will be labelled "{{target}}" instead, and "{{source}}" is deleted.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this label?
confirmDelete.description: It is removed from every note that carries it. The notes themselves stay.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.description: The app hit an unexpected error. Your notes are safe on this device - reloading should get you back.

dnd.instructions: Press Space to pick this up, the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, and Escape to cancel.
dnd.lifted: {{name}} picked up. It is at position {{position}}.

capture.title: Start anything
capture.body: Text, a checklist, a photo, a voice memo or a drawing - every way in starts here.

editor.title: Write it
editor.body: Type / anywhere in a note for headings, lists, quotes and maths. Images, audio, files and drawings go inline, in the note itself.

wall.title: Your wall
wall.body: Pin a note to keep it on top, give it a colour or a label. Archive keeps it, trash lets it go with a moment to change your mind - and {{mod}} K finds any of them.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.body: Choose which buttons the editor's toolbar carries, which order the quick starts come in, and which thumb the ＋ sits under.

local.title: It all lives here
local.body: Every note is on this device and nowhere else. Install the app to keep it a tap away, and export a zip whenever you want a copy.

weekend.intro: Train leaves Friday at six, so pack the night before.
weekend.item1: Book the room near the station
weekend.item2: The observatory, if it stays clear

ideas.body: A shelf for the hallway - measure the alcove first.
